description: Multiple sites use 'if let Some(ref k) = ...' instead of the modern 'if let Some(k) = &...' form. Sites: chat.rs:59 (filter_kind), chat.rs:326 (m.role inside closure), space.rs (search 'ref ' for full list), misc.rs:116 (patch.presence). The 'ref' keyword in patterns is older syntax that predates the post-2018 'match ergonomics' that made plain 'Some(k)' against &T sufficient. Engineering basis: idiom-consistency — modern Rust code rarely uses 'ref' in patterns; clippy's lint 'needless_borrow' and friends flag related anti-patterns. The fix is mechanical (s/Some(ref k)/Some(k) = &.../). Mark as clippy-priority (P2) per Section 'Clippy and language idioms' of the review guide.
title: Builder uses 'if let Some(ref k) =' instead of 'if let Some(k) = &'
